extracted.intended_audience: Agency deputy directors, staff chiefs, division reporting officers responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit the Agency-wide management improvement program report required by OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), including specified sections on goals and accomplishments for management effectiveness and cost reduction, using both narrative and statistical material where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish a formal Agency-wide management improvement program
rubrics_metrics.description: In compliance with OMB Circular No. A-44 (Revised), establish a formal Agency-wide management improvement program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference (c) (Agency Management Improvement Program Implementation Instruction) 'sets forth the policies, procedures and guidelines and assigns responsibilities for carrying out the program.' Follow those policies and assigned responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare a consolidated report containing Sections I–IV
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a consolidated report which contains the following sections: Section I — Management Effectiveness Goals (FY1971); Section II — Cost Reduction Goals (FY1971); Section III — Management Effectiveness Accomplishments (FY1970); Section IV — Cost Reduction Accomplishment (FY1970).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the named sections exactly and attach any supporting material as 'Attachments i As Stated Above.' Use the distribution list and routing instructions provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide both narrative and statistical reports where possible (current and upcoming fiscal year)
rubrics_metrics.description: For the current and upcoming fiscal year, prepare both statistical and narrative reports where possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum explicitly directs that both statistical and narrative reports should be prepared where possible — apply this to the goals sections covering the current and upcoming fiscal year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare narrative and statistical reports for Sections III and IV per reference (c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions concerning the preparation of Sections III (Management Effectiveness Accomplishments FY1970) and IV (Cost Reduction Accomplishment FY1970) are detailed in reference (c).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where possible, prepare both narrative and statistical reports for Sections III and IV as specified on pages 3 and 4 of reference (c). Follow the detailed formatting/content instructions in that reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow consolidation and distribution procedures in reference (c) (Section XX)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the procedures in Section XX of reference (c) to prepare/distribute a consolidated report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directors and staffs are to refer to Section XX (Reference c) for consolidating and distributing reports; observe due dates and routing instructions and refer questions to the Chief of the Executive and Planning Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover both goals and accomplishments with specified fiscal-year framing
rubrics_metrics.description: Reports must separately state goals (FY1971) and accomplishments (FY1970) for both management effectiveness and cost reduction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the report distinguishes between goals (planned targets for the upcoming fiscal year) and accomplishments (results from the prior fiscal year) in both narrative and statistical forms where possible.
